name: Almutawa - Finance Intake (bank SMS + emails)
description: Receives bank/payment notifications (iPhone SMS via Shortcut webhook, or emails from watcher workflows), extracts the transaction with AI, saves it as needs_review, creates a tx_review approval and asks the owner what it was for.

parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'name', name, 'bank', bank, 'hint', hint, 'scope', scope)), '[]'::json) FROM finance_accounts WHERE active) AS accounts, (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', id, 'title', title, 'counterparty', counterparty, 'amount', amount, 'scope', scope)), '[]'::json) FROM recurring_commitments WHERE active) AS commitments

WITH tx AS (INSERT INTO finance_transactions (occurred_at, account, scope, direction, amount, currency, counterparty, category, description, source, source_ref, status, account_id, commitment_id, raw_text) VALUES (COALESCE(NULLIF($1,'')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bahrain', now()), COALESCE(NULLIF($2,''),'unknown'), $3, $4, $5::numeric, $6, NULLIF($7,''), NULLIF($8,''), $9, $10, $11, 'needs_review', NULLIF($12,'')::int, NULLIF($13,'')::int, $14) ON CONFLICT (source_ref) DO NOTHING RETURNING id), ap AS (INSERT INTO approvals (request_type, summary, details, amount_bhd, requested_by, channel) SELECT 'tx_review', $15, jsonb_build_object('tx_id', id, 'question', $16, 'category_guess', $8, 'scope', $3), CASE WHEN $6 = 'BHD' THEN $5::numeric ELSE NULL END, 'finance_assistant', 'inbox' FROM tx RETURNING id) SELECT (SELECT id FROM tx) AS tx_id, (SELECT id FROM ap) AS approval_id

value.title: ={{ $('Parse Transaction').first().json.summary }}
value.body: ={{ $('Parse Transaction').first().json.question + '\nالتصنيف المقترح: ' + ($('Parse Transaction').first().json.category || '-') + '\nجاوب في المحادثة أو من خانة الموافقات.' }}
